current_date: November 2025 (cover date; the 'New Local Validation Checklist 2025' page says it takes effect Friday 7 November 2025 and applies to applications received on or after Monday 10 November 2025)
current_evidence: The official 'New Local Validation Checklist 2025' page and search index point to 2025-Local-Validation-Checklist-final.pdf dated November 2025. Grokbot's 'Updated-21-10-26' file returned a 4xx error twice (www and non-www) while other dartmoor.gov.uk PDFs fetched normally. Its BNG text ('from the 6th August there are some changes to the statutory exemptions') is not in the Nov 2025 edition, so Grokbot may have read a later October 2026 revision that has since been moved; that could not be verified.

issues.detail: 10 of the 12 tab_items are process text or boilerplate, not requirements: the GDPR/personal data paragraphs (x3), 'All documents will be loaded to the public access area', the Planning Portal acknowledgement / 15 working days validation target, 'hold your application for a maximum of 15 working days', 'resubmit a new application', 'Validation disputes ... Section 12', a fragment that merges the PiP list with the LBC heading ('Application Form ... Site Location Plan Relevant Fee 17 Listed Building Consent...'), and 'Paper copies of the forms can be downloaded ... Archaeological Assessment When required:'. One item also merges the GDPR text with the Householder heading.
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Submission rules' section; source introduction pages 4-6.

issues.detail: Several mandatory local requirements are missing from the app_type_rows. (1) Dartmoor Wildlife Trigger Table: mandatory for Householder, Full (major and minor), Outline and Listed Building Consent. (2) Biodiversity Enhancement (local requirement): mandatory for Householder and for schemes under 2 homes, 100 sqm of non-residential floorspace or 0.2 ha that are not subject to BNG. (3) Carbon Reduction Statement: new in 2025, required for 'all planning applications', including Householder, Outline and Reserved Matters. (4) Roof Plan (existing and proposed): for development involving new roofs or roof alterations.
issues.evidence: Householder must-submit list: 'Dartmoor Wildlife Trigger Table; Biodiversity Enhancement (local requirement); Carbon Reduction Statement'. Glossary: Carbon Reduction Statement, 'When required: all planning applications'.
issues.grok_comment: Wildlife Trigger Table, Carbon Reduction Statement ("When required: all planning applications") and Roof Plan are missing as claimed. But in the workbook's source (the Updated-21-10-26 version), the Householder must-submit list is the plans plus "Dartmoor Wildlife Trigger Table / Carbon Reduction Statement", with no Biodiversity Enhancement; that section survives only in the contents page.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. Wildlife Trigger Table, Carbon Reduction Statement and Roof Plan are still missing; Biodiversity Enhancement is withdrawn for the version Grokbot used.

issues.detail: Many conditional local requirements were not captured: Habitable Floorspace Calculation (any increase in habitable floorspace, and replacement dwellings); Evidence for Replacement Homes (wholescale replacement of a dwelling); Housing Needs Assessment (6+ houses in Local Centres, 4+ homes in Rural Settlements, Villages and Hamlets); Low Impact Residential Development Evidence (proposals under policy 3.12); Equestrian Development Information (all equestrian development, including private stabling); Agriculture or Forestry Business Plan (new agricultural buildings, and diversification schemes); Renewable and Low Carbon Energy (proposals incorporating renewables); Town Centre Sequential Test and Impact Assessment (main town centre uses of 150 sqm or more); Simple Calculation of Atmospheric Impact Levels (SCAIL); Energy Efficiency Report; Telecommunications Statement; Hedgerow Removal Notice checklist.
issues.evidence: Glossary 'When required' entries, e.g. Housing Needs Assessment: 'development of 6 houses or more within Local Centres ... 4 homes or more within Rural Settlements, Villages and Hamlets'.

issues.detail: Sustainable Drainage Strategy is mandatory for Full (major and minor) and conditional for Householder, Outline and Reserved Matters. It is not captured as such: Grokbot's 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' row actually quotes the Foul Drainage Assessment (non-mains drainage) text.
issues.evidence: Glossary: Sustainable Drainage Strategy, 'all planning applications which could affect drainage on or around the site'. Full minor must-submit list includes 'Sustainable Drainage Strategy'.

issues.detail: Outline and Reserved Matters are marked '(none)', but the source has local requirements for both. Outline must submit the Dartmoor Wildlife Trigger Table, Biodiversity Enhancement or BNG, a Carbon Reduction Statement and a Planning Statement, plus a long 'may also need' list. Reserved Matters must submit a Carbon Reduction Statement, Design and Access Statement and Planning Statement.
issues.evidence: 'Outline Application ... Dartmoor Wildlife trigger table; Either Biodiversity Enhancement ... or Biodiversity Net Gain; Carbon Reduction Statement; Planning Statement'.

issues.detail: Contaminated Land Assessment and Lighting Assessment are placed under Householder, although the source explicitly excludes householder applications from both.
issues.evidence: 'Contaminated Land Assessment When required: development (except Householder development)...'; 'Lighting Assessment/ Plan When required: all schemes incorporating external lighting (except Householder applications)'.

issues.detail: Several requirements are attached to the wrong application type. 'Archaeological Assessment' is under Advertisement consent, but that text is the tail of the LBC 'may also need' list; the advert checklist has no archaeology item. 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' is under Variation of condition s73, but s73 needs a description of the conditions plus the Wildlife Trigger Table and surveys if relevant. 'Fire Statement' and 'Floor plans' are under Change of use - prior approval, but the Prior Notification checklist requires only the fee, form and a scaled site plan. 'Ventilation / Extraction (odour)' is under Minerals & waste, but the text is the Noise Impact Assessment trigger.
issues.evidence: Advert checklist: fee, form, location plan, block plan, elevations only. Prior Notification: 'Relevant Fee; Application form; A metric scaled plan indicating the site'.

issues.detail: About 25 rows are flagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' (e.g. Agricultural Appraisal, BNG, Flood Risk Assessment, Noise, Marketing Evidence, Gypsy and Traveller Assessment). The source has explicit per-type lists, and most of these apply equally to Outline and Reserved Matters. The source also splits Full into Major and Minor with different mandatory sets, which Grokbot does not reflect. For example, Street Scene, LVIA, Transport Statement and Waste Audit are mandatory only for Major, while Design and Access Statement is mandatory for Major but conditional for Minor.
issues.evidence: 'Full Applications - Major' vs 'Full Applications - Minor' must-submit lists.

issues.detail: For Listed Building Consent, the mandatory Dartmoor Wildlife Trigger Table and Design and Access Statement were not captured. Only floor plans, the heritage statement and the schedule of works are listed.
issues.evidence: LBC must-submit list: 'Dartmoor Wildlife Trigger Table; Design and Access Statement; Statement of Heritage Significance; Schedule of Works'.

issues.detail: Several triggers are sentence fragments with no actual trigger: Arboricultural Impact Assessment / Tree Survey ('such as arboriculturist, drainage engineer or structural engineer is required.'), Structural Survey ('engineer or structural engineer is required.') and Sequential / Exception Test ('flood risk Sequential Test can be satisfied.').

Several triggers quote text belonging to a different requirement. 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage' quotes equestrian development text (grazing, DEFRA horse welfare code). 'Character / Conservation area appraisal' quotes the BNG text. 'Telecommunications supplementary information' and 'Pre-application advice' quote the LVIA text. 'Highways / access (visibility splays)' quotes a block plan fragment. 'Ecological Survey' quotes the hedgerow checklist plus the Accessible Dwellings glossary. 'Design and Access Statement', 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' and 'Planning Statement' quote the 'You may also need to submit' list rather than a trigger.

Some rows duplicate others. Under Householder, 'Validation checklist form (completed)' repeats the Dartmoor Householder Wildlife Checklist row. Under Full, 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' and 'Foul Sewage / Utilities Statement' both carry the same Foul Drainage Assessment text, and 'Transport Assessment' and 'Travel Plan' carry the same text.

summary: Grokbot's 'Updated-21-10-26' link fails to fetch. The verifiable current list is the November 2025 checklist (effective 7 Nov 2025), and the workbook date comes from metadata. The extraction is weak: tab_items are mostly process text, key mandatory local items (Wildlife Trigger Table, Biodiversity Enhancement, Carbon Reduction Statement, Habitable Floorspace, Housing Needs) are missing, Outline and Reserved Matters are wrongly marked '(none)', and many triggers are fragments or misattributed.

withdrawn_issues.detail: Grokbot's Validation list URL does not resolve: it returned a client error on two attempts. The only official checklist that could be fetched is 2025-Local-Validation-Checklist-final.pdf (asset 571805). If an 'Updated 21-10-26' revision exists, the link to it has broken or moved, so the workbook should be re-pointed or re-verified.
withdrawn_issues.evidence: WebFetch: 'failed at its site (client_error)' for asset 0033/193767. The council page 'New Local Validation Checklist 2025' links 'Access New Local Validation Checklist HERE'.
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: The workbook URL (asset 0033/193767 'Updated-21-10-26') was captured successfully: raw/dartmoor_national_park_authority/3d7c54c656.txt is an 89 KB copy of that exact URL. Both it and the 571805 URL now return HTTP 403 (a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge) to automated fetches, so this looks like bot-blocking, not a dead link.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The site uses bot-blocking (Cloudflare), so this is not a dead link.

withdrawn_issues.detail: The List date 2026-10-01 comes from PDF CreationDate metadata, not from the document text. The checklist that could be fetched is dated 'November 2025' and took effect 7 Nov 2025. Grokbot's own filename suggests an update dated 21-10-26, which also does not match 1 Oct 2026.
withdrawn_issues.evidence: PDF cover: 'Local Validation Checklist ... November 2025'. Council page: 'takes effect on Friday 7 November 2025 ... applications received on or after Monday 10 November 2025'.
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: The cover does say "November 2025", but the workbook's source is the revision named 'Updated-21-10-26', so an October 2026 date is defensible for that file (not just raw metadata).
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The October 2026 date is defensible for the file Grokbot used.

withdrawn_issues.detail: The Dartmoor Householder Wildlife Checklist trigger leaves out its limiting condition. It applies only where the ecology report identifies bat roost or bird nesting issues, not to every householder application with an ecology report.
withdrawn_issues.evidence: 'householder applications with an Ecology Report identifying bat roost or bird nesting issues ONLY'.
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: In the workbook's source version (Updated-21-10-26, raw 3d7c54c656), the Dartmoor Householder Wildlife Checklist trigger reads only "householder applications with an Ecology Report." The "bat roost or bird nesting issues ONLY" qualifier is not in it, so the workbook matches its source.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The trigger matches the version Grokbot used.

grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
review_note: After Grok's review: the link is behind Cloudflare bot-blocking, not dead. Grokbot read an 'Updated 21-10-26' revision; whether that is still the current one is unclear.
